run_correlation_analysis: run correlation analysis on annotated data evaluations for a specific dataset like drop or gsm8k
run_correlation_all_datasets: run correlation analysis across all datasets drop gsm8k esnli cosmos and semeval at once
make_correlations_table: compute Somers D correlation and p-value tables between ROSCOE scores and human annotation labels
process_values: parse and aggregate human annotation rows and model scores into a values dictionary for correlation analysis
generate_scores_and_correls_for_dataset: generate correlation tables and granular summaries for a single dataset with optional baseline scores
